title: GitHub Trending Summary - Weekly - 2026-10-16
ranking_basis: GitHub Trending weekly star gains, sorted descending by displayed gain
ranking_explanation: The GitHub weekly Trending page supplied reported gains; entries are ordered from largest to smallest displayed weekly gain.
global_caveat: GitHub REST was used to corroborate repository identity, current total stars, and default-branch commit. It does not validate weekly historical gains or star provenance. REA’s reported +239,477 weekly gain is exceptionally large and remains unverified independently.

themes.name: Agent skills, plugins and workflow packaging
Agents producing visual, video and CAD artifacts

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Agent-oriented repositories dominate this week: REA leads GitHub Trending by a very large reported margin, while skills/plugins and agent-assisted creative tooling recur across the rest of the list. The weekly gain shown for REA is unusually high and should be read as a platform-reported signal, not independently verified organic growth.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: The list clusters around agent skills and plugins (mattpocock/skills, cursor/plugins, SwiftUI-Agent-Skill), agents that create diagrams, video and CAD (diagram-design, HyperFrames, text-to-cad), and reverse engineering or compatibility tooling (REA, Ghidra, AnyPS5). TypeScript leads among listed language-tagged repositories (4); C++, Shell, HTML, Java, JavaScript and Python each appear once, while SwiftUI-Agent-Skill has no primary language reported by GitHub.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The strongest signal is the shift from agents that only write code toward packaged workflows and tools that produce inspectable artifacts or analyze software. Creative generation, engineering skills and low-level analysis all show up together. Treat extreme weekly star-gain figures cautiously: GitHub’s view and current REST metadata corroborate the repositories and current star counts, but not the historical net additions or their provenance.
